thread:
sre-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — HIGH_GPU_QUEUE in eu-west-1. autoscaler attempted scale but hit cluster max_nodes. queue_length=12000, avg_wait=18s, 5xx spike from inference tier. root: 1759004321

elena: paging oncall — enterprise customers reporting 503s on /v1/generate and slow streaming. seeing lots of throttled tokens. Suspect gpu-pool-eu-west-1 reached max node count.

ryan: ack, I'm oncall. pulling autoscaler logs now. Preliminary: scale event at 1759004300 attempted +10 nodes but rejected: "max_nodes reached (40)".

elena: confirmed in metrics. Two customers (CUST-232, CUST-901) have >40% error rate on inference calls. Marking P1.

ops-emma: can we do a manual max_nodes bump? cloud console shows region quota 42/40 for GPU instances. Need manual quota/limit ops.

ryan: trying manual scale command now: 
```
gcloud container clusters update redwood-eu --node-pool gpu-pool-eu --max-nodes=60
```

deploy-bot: Manual scaling initiated by ryan at 1759004382. request_id=req-9b2f.

ryan: cloud API error: "Quota exceeded: requested GPUs 20, available 0 in region eu-west-1". so we can't create new GPU nodes without quota increase.

lucas: I've got infra-ops on the phone with cloud support. There's an emergency quota path; starting escalation now. tagging support case SC-998271. ETA 45-90m for provider-side approval.

elena: if quota will take a while, can we shift traffic to fallback models? option: route non-critical customers to quantized-cpu fallback or lower batch-size model to free GPU capacity.

ryan: starting routing change: `redwood route update --region eu-west-1 --policy emergency-fallback --fallback-model fast-quantized-v2 --pct=30` — applying now.

ops-emma: routing toggled. Observability: token throughput dropped ~28% on GPU pool and 503 rate reduced for top 5 tenants. Tail latency for remaining GPU traffic still elevated.

customer-notify-bot: Notifying affected customers: CUST-232, CUST-901. Template sent: "We're investigating elevated errors for inference in eu-west-1. Temporary routing to fallback model in place; working on capacity increase. We'll follow up with ETA."

elena: rolling handoff in 30m — lucas will take primary while I prep comms and postmortem stub.

lucas: taking over now. cloud support confirms emergency quota request filed, priority raised. They asked for justification details which I've provided (prod outage, number of GPUs required, expected duration).

ryan: added temporary admission controller tweak to reduce pod concurrency for best-effort queues to buy headroom: `k8s patch` applied. This should reduce queue pressure but increase processing time per request for affected traffic.

ops-emma: confirm: we've also set autoscaler override window to allow burst_scaling until 1759008282 (approx +1h). This is a local policy change that allows creation of ephemeral burst nodes if provider quota available.

lucas: cloud support email: "We can approve 20 additional GPUs within 60 mins if usage justification holds." Filed follow-up to expedite.

elena: summary of impact so far: - CUST-232 and CUST-901 partial failures (503s) until routing applied - overall request latency improved after fallback routing - no data loss - mitigation: fallback routing + admission control + cloud quota escalation.

ryan: created infra PR to prevent future hard max_nodes limit for gpu-pool: `infra#3421` — change includes emergency burst pool, better autoscaler backoff, and a telemetry alert to pre-warn at 80% capacity.

customer-notify-bot: Update sent to customers: "We have implemented a temporary routing fallback and raised a quota escalation with our cloud provider. We'll update within 60-90 minutes or earlier."

lucas: continuing to monitor. next updates at +15m. tagging docs for postmortem: incident/external-communication-needed.

elena: ACTIONS (assigned):
- lucas: track cloud support, confirm quota approval or alternative (ETA)
- ryan: follow up infra PR and ensure autoscaler override is reverted after incident
- ops-emma: monitor node creation attempts and revoke burst policy if unintended nodes spin up
- elena: finalize customer comms and postmortem stub

elena: final note for now: root cause is autoscaler ceiling combined with exhausted regional GPU quota. Long-term fix: emergency burst pool + pre-warn alerts + quota monitoring.

sre-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: incident severity P1, status=mitigating, responders={elena, ryan, lucas, ops-emma}.
